ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Banksy's New Work in Port Talbot

fullPassage:
Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire.
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air.
Banksy's art has included environmental messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a plant in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "I remember when all this was trees."

questions.passage:
Secretive street artist Banksy designed another ①<u>interesting</u> piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child ③<u>catching</u> snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash ②<u>came</u> from a dumpster fire.
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would ④<u>highlight</u> Port Talbot's dust problem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ①interesting: 형용사 수식 정상

❌ ②came → coming: ash coming from(현재분사 후치수식). came(과거형)은 수식 불가 ←정답

✅ ③catching: shows a child catching(현재분사) 정상

✅ ④highlight: would highlight(조동사+원형) 정상
det.tip: ash coming from ~: ~에서 나오는 재. 현재분사 coming이 ash를 수식.

questions.passage:
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by ①<u>playing</u> in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
Children are particularly ②<u>defenseless</u> against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the WHO, about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in ③<u>toxically</u> air every day.
Banksy's art has ④<u>included</u> environmental messages before.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ①playing: by playing(전치사+동명사) 정상

✅ ②defenseless: 보어 형용사 정상

❌ ③toxically → toxic: 명사 air를 수식하므로 형용사 toxic 필요. toxically(부사)는 명사 수식 불가 ←정답

✅ ④included: has included(현재완료) 정상
det.tip: 형용사 vs 부사: toxic(형용사) air / toxically(부사)는 명사 수식 불가.

questions.passage:
Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, ①<u>which</u> appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ①which: 계속적 용법 관계대명사(선행사 art) 정상

✅ ②that: 관계대명사(선행사 art) 정상

❌ ③was → were: the area's children(복수 주어)에 were 필요 ←정답

✅ ④was: all this(단수 취급)에 was 정상
det.tip: children(복수) → were. all this(단수) → was. 주어-동사 수 일치 구분.

det.analysis:
❌ ①ignore(무시하다) — 원문은 highlight(부각시키다). Owen이 문제를 알리려는 맥락에서 무시는 반대 ←정답

✅ ②dumpster(쓰레기통) — 원문 그대로

✅ ③snowflakes(눈송이) — 원문 그대로

✅ ④serious(심각한) — 원문 그대로
det.tip: highlight(부각) ↔ ignore(무시). Owen이 예술로 문제를 알리려 함.

questions.passage: Children are particularly ①<u>defenseless</u> against air pollution. Since they have ②<u>slower</u> breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. det.analysis:
✅ ①defenseless(무방비의) — 원문 그대로

❌ ②slower(느린) — 원문은 faster(빠른). 빠른 호흡 → 오염물질 더 많이 흡입이라는 인과관계에서 느린은 반대 ←정답

✅ ③toxic(유독한) — 원문 그대로

✅ ④died(사망했다) — 원문 그대로
det.tip: faster(빠른) ↔ slower(느린). 빠른 호흡이 더 많은 오염물질 흡입의 원인.

det.analysis:
❌ ①tourism industry(관광 산업) — 본문 맥락과 무관

❌ ②art festival(예술 축제) — 본문 맥락과 무관

❌ ③cultural heritage(문화 유산) — 문제 부각과 맞지 않음

det.tip: dust problem = 분진 문제. highlight(부각시키다)의 대상.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ①environmental messages(환경 메시지) — Port Talbot 분진 + Detroit 공장 터 = 환경 주제 ←정답

❌ ②political advertisements(정치 광고) — 본문 맥락과 무관

❌ ③commercial slogans(상업 슬로건) — 환경 메시지와 무관

❌ ④religious symbols(종교 상징) — 본문에 없음

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 아이의 입은 처음부터 재를 향해 열려 있는 것처럼 보인다
